software_documentation_ptb_schema.purpose: Reusable local schema for PTB/WELMEC-aligned documentation and update plans.
software_documentation_ptb_schema.selection_rule: A documentation plan chooses exactly one profile as structure. Other PTB references may be cross-references only when evidenced.
software_documentation_ptb_schema.claim_boundary: This schema produces reviewable documentation scaffolding, not conformity, certification or legal approval.

test_plan_schema.purpose: Small, project-native unit test planning and optional test patches.
test_plan_schema.write_gate: Write tests only when behavior and framework evidence are clear.

resource_reuse_schema.purpose: Identify local resources before creating new code/docs/tests.

reference_domains.label: Software Documentation Planning Reference
rules: Use a documented structure before writing prose.
Separate documentation content, update plan, validation proof and known gaps.
Do not use documentation to claim compliance.

source_refs.label: Write the Docs software documentation guide

reference_domains.label: Unit Testing / Small Tests Reference
rules: Prefer small deterministic tests for isolated behavior.
Reuse the existing project test framework and fixtures.
Escalate to integration/smoke only when a unit boundary is not evidenced.

reference_domains.label: Local Resource Reuse Reference
rules: Search selected scope, imports and dependency layer before adding new resources.
Prefer existing utilities, components, fixtures and docs when fit is evidenced.
Report reuse candidates and why they were selected or rejected.

operation_roles.label: Documentation Update Planning Operator
rules: Choose exactly one documentation schema profile.
Build an evidence matrix from local project facts.
Write update plan and manifest delta together.

operation_roles.label: Unit Test Planning Operator
rules: Detect existing test framework before writing tests.
Prefer small tests and existing fixtures.
If no framework evidence exists, produce a plan/manual gap instead of installing dependencies.

operation_roles.label: Local Resource Reuse Operator
rules: Inspect local candidates before creating code/docs/tests.
Do not duplicate utilities or schemas that already exist.
Record selected and rejected reuse candidates.

weight_operators.label: Unit Test Planning Weight Operator
rules: Small deterministic tests are preferred.
No new framework dependency without evidence or explicit user request.

weight_operators.label: Resource Reuse Weight Operator
rules: Existing local resources are preferred when fit is evidenced.
Do not overfit by reusing a resource solely because of a similar name.

hooks.label: Unit Test Plan Evidence Gate
rules: Require framework evidence or manual gap before writing test files.
Prefer project-native test commands.

hooks.label: Local Resource Reuse Gate
rules: Scan local candidates before creating new resources.
Report reuse candidates in output.
